visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with high-altitude aerial drone shots of lush, sun-drenched mountains and terraced valleys in Taiwan. A white Toyota van is seen navigating a narrow, winding asphalt road through a green landscape. (2) Inside the van, two men wearing sunglasses are engaged in conversation. One is a middle-aged man with a small ponytail (Tai-zhi), and the other is a younger man with glasses. They are seen in a medium close-up. (3) A series of quick cuts follows, showing the men in various rural settings: they are seen in a greenhouse harvesting red passion fruits into a black basket, then visiting an elderly woman in a humble indoor home setting where they interact warmly. (4) The scene shifts to a workshop where close-up shots capture hands precisely working with a grinding tool on a piece of stone or ceramic. The men are then seen wading through a clear, rocky stream, laughing and splashing. (5) The middle-aged man speaks directly to the camera in a professional talking-head setup against a blurred green background. Finally, the duo is seen relaxing in outdoor wooden tubs filled with water and apples at night, followed by a large white title overlay appearing over the scene.

The narrator's pitch is stable, conveying warmth and pride as he discusses the value of local language. (3) A distinct mechanical grinding sound (stone tool) breaks the flow briefly, followed by the sound of splashing water and distant bird-like chirping. (4) The music tempo remains constant, with the narrator shifting to an excited, high-arousal tone to announce a new TV show. (5) The audio concludes with the sound of many people laughing and a loud splash, blended with a final musical crescendo.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a new TV show on the PTS Taiwanese Channel (公視台語台) hosted by Tai-zhi, titled '來去恁兜洗魂舒'. The video uses nostalgic and scenic imagery of rural Taiwan to advocate for the preservation of the Taiwanese language and local culture while showcasing the fun and immersive nature of the upcoming program.
